items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: Willie Pardew played a while in the band and Rick Ard, he played a while.

ctx.x: I see When you first joined the band who was playing trombone? He was playing trombone?

Oh no. Otherwise Sam came in our band his other band his band he's been with they went and they took the they got Willie Pardew. Willie Pardew played a while in the band and Rick Ard, he played a while. And after that the band is built up you see? His old band but Sam was continued Sam was with our band.
Let me get your ass straight.
